2. In the original grid, the missing vertical lines have successive gaps of approximately \(33,47,69\) pixels. The missing horizontal lines have gaps of approximately \(66,23,44\) pixels.
3. At the reduced scale, this produces the distinctive narrow–medium–wide vertical spacing and nonuniform horizontal spacing.
4. Choices C and E contain an extra horizontal line, while A and D have incorrect vertical spacing. Choice B matches all four vertical and four horizontal positions.

\[
\boxed{\mathrm{B}}
